verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not mention automatic punctuation, casing, number or entity formatting, or a way to turn formatting off. The cited items cover custom dictionaries, domain models, diarization and language ID, which are adjacent features. This is a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off
